info.title: MeOS application contract
info.description: Planner contract. Browser transport uses same-origin native session and CSRF. MCP uses separate owner-bound native identities at /api/meos/v1/mcp; not a raw database API.

post.description: Read one exact day or inclusive seven-day note with its revision; missing returns null. Daily reflections belong here by default, not in duplicate local Markdown. Read before appending; preserve human prose.

Append an emoji/author-attributed reflection without replacing human prose. Read first; expectedRevision=0 requires absence. Supply a stable UUID for creation and reuse the exact idempotencyKey and input on uncertain retries. Source and caller-reported reconciliation outcome are retained in the command receipt; outcome does not perform or prove Calendar reconciliation. Run the reset/reschedule procedures as directed with these journal changes, within existing authority. Prefer rescheduling to unscheduling where possible, unless otherwise directed. Reply to the user with a concise summary of the changes and any unresolved blockers. Consider reported actual-time corrections and authorized future recalculation. Fresh-read occurrences, agenda and Calendar; apply revision-checked changes within existing authority, then verify Calendar propagation. Ordinary timing uses 15-minute precision; preserve explicit precise exceptions. Distinguish elapsed, focused and planned duration; do not infer finishes or change routine defaults. Note saved is not Calendar reconciled; reported outcomes are caller claims, not backend verification.

post.description: Search owner planning records and period notes. Keyword works without a provider. Hybrid returns a queryJob when pending; an authorized external embedding capability can generate it and call search_query_commit, then repeat search. Without that capability use lexical results immediately. Never use relevance for exact agenda retrieval.
Indexing readiness and backlog; does not lease jobs or contact the provider.
Enable or disable embedding work for this owner. Enable only after consent to send planning text to your authorized embedding provider. Fixed v1 model and dimensions.

Lease up to 8 owner-scoped embedding jobs, optionally targeting one job/source. Embed exact returned text. Leases start at 60 seconds and back off to one hour; expiry permits retry but does not run a producer.

Commit derived embeddings bound to job revision, model, dimensions, index/input version and SHA-256 input hash. Does not emit source updates. Stale identity returns accepted=false; identical successful replay is harmless.
Commit only an owner-bound query embedding descriptor returned by search; never document jobs. Does not require all-document indexing authority or emit source events.
Publish bounded pages of the credential-free Calendar cache from the dedicated sync principal. Only a complete fenced snapshot becomes visible.

Read owner-scoped cached Calendar context, including all-day and linked events, for an inclusive date range. Check status, lastSyncAt and recurrence window; unavailable is not empty. Primary events are read-only. Follow nextCursor.
Read the current task or occurrence, including a retained deletion tombstone, before handling a boundary.
Read the persisted result of one owner command idempotency key; this is not a delivery receipt.
Read owner-scoped Calendar-sync entities; never other resources.
Read committed task/instance outbox changes; cursor advances only after durable sync receipts.
Read current sync entity or retained tombstone.
Apply remote Calendar fields only with current local revision. Retains identity, rich notes unless changed, completion, intent, history and sibling instances.
List scheduled tasks and independent routine instances for a local date; excludes unscheduled, skipped and archived items.
Create a task; schedule is optional. Repeated idempotency key returns its original result.

Create a routine template without creating occurrences or scheduling events. Frequency and duration are template intent; exact timing belongs to occurrences. Repeated idempotency key returns its original result.
Replace routine template with revision check; existing occurrences are unchanged.
Edit or move one occurrence without changing its original slot, template or siblings.
Set one occurrence completion with revision and retry protection.
Validate a proposed schedule atomically without writing. Preferences do not automatically assign times.
Atomically apply explicit scheduling decisions with per-record revisions and retry protection.

Explicit planning only: atomically materialize selected revision-checked fixed routines within each routine-local date window, from today through at most 14 days ahead. Preserve existing slots. Replay identical input and idempotencyKey after uncertain success. At most 100 routines and 15 candidate slot IDs per routine; no automatic rollover.
Expand fixed recurrence from actual current local day through at most 14 days ahead. Existing slots preserved; flexible intents require scheduler decisions.
Delete a task and retain a tombstone plus transactional sync deletion.
Bind a stable remote calendar event identity without reassigning existing mappings.

get.description: Owner-only inclusive date window (at most 93 days), 250 events per page. Poll with a known sequence: unchanged responses contain current metadata but no events. Follow nextCursor with that sequence; 409 means restart the window.
